prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1393; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our client. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

Your company is on notice of a potential claim and of pending litigation. We request that you preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, dashcam or surveillance video, vehicle data, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and the policy in force at the time of the loss. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such materials.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
